events.verdict: Martin (PHI) legally contests Miller's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Maxey (PHI) re-adjusts his path and Green (CHA) continues moving forwards into him, initiating body contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Richards (CHA) wraps Maxey (PHI), which affects his ability to pursue the loose ball.
Miller (CHA) releases away from Maxey (PHI) after the pick and the contact is marginal.
Maxey (PHI) legally contests Miller's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Yabusele (PHI) moves forwards into Simpson (CHA), initiating lower body contact that causes him to lose his balance.

Salaun (CHA) establishes himself in a legal guarding position in Maxey's (PHI) path and outside of the restricted area. Maxey is able to slip the contact with Salaun and the resulting contact is marginal.
Maxey (PHI) loses control of the ball and is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. Possession should have been given to Charlotte.
Martin (CHA) briefly places a hand to Maxey's (PHI) front as he rests a forearm against his body and the contact during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) legally contests Miller's (CHA) driving shot attempt.
Green (CHA) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
Richards (CHA) gathers the pass on his right foot and takes two steps before the shot attempt at the rim.
Simpson (CHA) attempts to get to the pass when he brushes Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) arm after receiving the pass. The contact is marginal and does not affect Oubre Jr.'s control of the ball.
Martin (CHA) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
Yabusele (PHI) and Micic (CHA) briefly engage and disengage during the throw-in.
